description:
Run a simulated conversation between one agent and a simulated user. This burns LLM credits but does not place a real call.

WHEN TO USE:
- Test prompt, voice, and tool-routing changes before telephony work
- Validate a draft or duplicate agent with one short starter message

EXAMPLE: {"agent_id": "agent_123", "user_message": "I need help rescheduling my appointment."}

RELATED TOOLS:
- update_agent: change the prompt or first message before re-running the simulation
- duplicate_agent: fork a production agent before testing variants
- make_outbound_call: only after the simulation looks correct

RETURNS: simulated_conversation and analysis.

COST: Uses ElevenLabs LLM/simulation credits.

disable_first_message_interruptions.description: Optional simulated-user flag mirroring the ElevenLabs API request shape.

language.description: Optional language for the simulated user (for example "en").

new_turns_limit.description: Maximum number of new turns to generate. Default: ElevenLabs API default.

user_message.description: Opening message for the simulated user. Keep it short for fast checks.

name: simulate_conversation
